sanskrit_shloka:
जनक उवाच ॥
क्व भूतानि क्व देहो वा क्वेन्द्रियाणि क्व वा मनः ।
क्व शून्यं क्व च नैराश्यं मत्स्वरूपे निरञ्जने ॥ २०-१॥
transliteration:
janaka uvāca ..
kva bhūtāni kva deho vā kvendriyāṇi kva vā manaḥ .
kva śūnyaṃ kva ca nairāśyaṃ matsvarūpe nirañjane .. 20-1..
translation:
Janaka said
: Where are the elements, the body, the senses, the mind, emptiness, or hopelessness? In my true nature, which is pure and stainless, none of these exist.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text:
Janaka said
: Where are the elements, the body, the senses, the mind, emptiness, or hopelessness? In my true nature, which is pure and stainless, none of these exist.

sanskrit_shloka:
क्व शास्त्रं क्वात्मविज्ञानं क्व वा निर्विषयं मनः ।
क्व तृप्तिः क्व वितृष्णात्वं गतद्वन्द्वस्य मे सदा ॥ २०-२॥
transliteration:
kva śāstraṃ kvātmavijñānaṃ kva vā nirviṣayaṃ manaḥ .
kva tṛptiḥ kva vitṛṣṇātvaṃ gatadvandvasya me sadā .. 20-2..
translation: Where are scriptures, self-knowledge, or the mind free of objects? Where is contentment or desirelessness for me, who is always free from dualities?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Where are scriptures, self-knowledge, or the mind free of objects? Where is contentment or desirelessness for me, who is always free from dualities?

sanskrit_shloka:
क्व विद्या क्व च वाविद्या क्वाहं क्वेदं मम क्व वा ।
क्व बन्ध क्व च वा मोक्षः स्वरूपस्य क्व रूपिता ॥ २०-३॥
transliteration:
kva vidyā kva ca vāvidyā kvāhaṃ kvedaṃ mama kva vā .
kva bandha kva ca vā mokṣaḥ svarūpasya kva rūpitā .. 20-3..
translation: Where are knowledge and ignorance? Where am "I" or "mine"? Where is bondage, where is liberation, and where is form for my true self?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Where are knowledge and ignorance? Where am "I" or "mine"? Where is bondage, where is liberation, and where is form for my true self?

sanskrit_shloka:
क्व प्रारब्धानि कर्माणि जीवन्मुक्तिरपि क्व वा ।
क्व तद् विदेहकैवल्यं निर्विशेषस्य सर्वदा ॥ २०-४॥
transliteration:
kva prārabdhāni karmāṇi jīvanmuktirapi kva vā .
kva tad videhakaivalyaṃ nirviśeṣasya sarvadā .. 20-4..
translation: Where are actions that have begun, and where is liberation while living? Where is the final disembodied liberation for one who is always undifferentiated?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Where are actions that have begun, and where is liberation while living? Where is the final disembodied liberation for one who is always undifferentiated?

sanskrit_shloka:
क्व कर्ता क्व च वा भोक्ता निष्क्रियं स्फुरणं क्व वा ।
क्वापरोक्षं फलं वा क्व निःस्वभावस्य मे सदा ॥ २०-५॥
transliteration:
kva kartā kva ca vā bhoktā niṣkriyaṃ sphuraṇaṃ kva vā .
kvāparokṣaṃ phalaṃ vā kva niḥsvabhāvasya me sadā .. 20-5..
translation: Where is the doer, the enjoyer, the non-acting awareness, or the immediate fruit of action? Where is any essence for me, who is always essence-less?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Where is the doer, the enjoyer, the non-acting awareness, or the immediate fruit of action? Where is any essence for me, who is always essence-less?

sanskrit_shloka:
क्व लोकं क्व मुमुक्षुर्वा क्व योगी ज्ञानवान् क्व वा ।
क्व बद्धः क्व च वा मुक्तः स्वस्वरूपेऽहमद्वये ॥ २०-६॥
transliteration:
kva lokaṃ kva mumukṣurvā kva yogī jñānavān kva vā .
kva baddhaḥ kva ca vā muktaḥ svasvarūpe'hamadvaye .. 20-6..
translation: Where is the world, the seeker of liberation, the yogi, or the knower of truth? Where is bondage or liberation in my non-dual nature?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Where is the world, the seeker of liberation, the yogi, or the knower of truth? Where is bondage or liberation in my non-dual nature?

sanskrit_shloka:
क्व सृष्टिः क्व च संहारः क्व साध्यं क्व च साधनम् ।
क्व साधकः क्व सिद्धिर्वा स्वस्वरूपेऽहमद्वये ॥ २०-७॥
transliteration:
kva sṛṣṭiḥ kva ca saṃhāraḥ kva sādhyaṃ kva ca sādhanam .
kva sādhakaḥ kva siddhirvā svasvarūpe'hamadvaye .. 20-7..
translation: Where is creation, destruction, the goal, the means, the seeker, or the attainment? In my non-dual nature, all these distinctions disappear.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Where is creation, destruction, the goal, the means, the seeker, or the attainment? In my non-dual nature, all these distinctions disappear.

sanskrit_shloka:
क्व प्रमाता प्रमाणं वा क्व प्रमेयं क्व च प्रमा ।
क्व किञ्चित् क्व न किञ्चिद् वा सर्वदा विमलस्य मे ॥ २०-८॥
transliteration:
kva pramātā pramāṇaṃ vā kva prameyaṃ kva ca pramā .
kva kiñcit kva na kiñcid vā sarvadā vimalasya me .. 20-8..
translation: Where is the knower, the means of knowledge, the object of knowledge, or knowledge itself? Where is something or nothing for me, who is ever pure?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Where is the knower, the means of knowledge, the object of knowledge, or knowledge itself? Where is something or nothing for me, who is ever pure?

sanskrit_shloka:
क्व विक्षेपः क्व चैकाग्र्यं क्व निर्बोधः क्व मूढता ।
क्व हर्षः क्व विषादो वा सर्वदा निष्क्रियस्य मे ॥ २०-९॥
transliteration:
kva vikṣepaḥ kva caikāgryaṃ kva nirbodhaḥ kva mūḍhatā .
kva harṣaḥ kva viṣādo vā sarvadā niṣkriyasya me .. 20-9..
translation: Where is distraction, concentration, wisdom, or delusion? Where is joy or sorrow for me, who is always actionless?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Where is distraction, concentration, wisdom, or delusion? Where is joy or sorrow for me, who is always actionless?

sanskrit_shloka:
क्व चैष व्यवहारो वा क्व च सा परमार्थता ।
क्व सुखं क्व च वा दुखं निर्विमर्शस्य मे सदा ॥ २०-१०॥
transliteration:
kva caiṣa vyavahāro vā kva ca sā paramārthatā .
kva sukhaṃ kva ca vā dukhaṃ nirvimarśasya me sadā .. 20-10..
translation: Where is worldly transaction or ultimate reality? Where is pleasure or pain for me, who is always free from thought?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Where is worldly transaction or ultimate reality? Where is pleasure or pain for me, who is always free from thought?

sanskrit_shloka:
क्व माया क्व च संसारः क्व प्रीतिर्विरतिः क्व वा ।
क्व जीवः क्व च तद्ब्रह्म सर्वदा विमलस्य मे ॥ २०-११॥
transliteration:
kva māyā kva ca saṃsāraḥ kva prītirviratiḥ kva vā .
kva jīvaḥ kva ca tadbrahma sarvadā vimalasya me .. 20-11..
translation: Where is illusion, where is the cycle of existence, where is attachment or detachment, where is the individual soul, and where is Brahman for me, who is always pure?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Where is illusion, where is the cycle of existence, where is attachment or detachment, where is the individual soul, and where is Brahman for me, who is always pure?

sanskrit_shloka:
क्व प्रवृत्तिर्निर्वृत्तिर्वा क्व मुक्तिः क्व च बन्धनम् ।
कूटस्थनिर्विभागस्य स्वस्थस्य मम सर्वदा ॥ २०-१२॥
transliteration:
kva pravṛttirnirvṛttirvā kva muktiḥ kva ca bandhanam .
kūṭasthanirvibhāgasya svasthasya mama sarvadā .. 20-12..
translation: Where is activity, inactivity, liberation, or bondage for me, who is immutable, indivisible, and always established in my true nature?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Where is activity, inactivity, liberation, or bondage for me, who is immutable, indivisible, and always established in my true nature?

sanskrit_shloka:
क्वोपदेशः क्व वा शास्त्रं क्व शिष्यः क्व च वा गुरुः ।
क्व चास्ति पुरुषार्थो वा निरुपाधेः शिवस्य मे ॥ २०-१३॥
transliteration:
kvopadeśaḥ kva vā śāstraṃ kva śiṣyaḥ kva ca vā guruḥ .
kva cāsti puruṣārtho vā nirupādheḥ śivasya me .. 20-13..
translation: Where is instruction, scripture, disciple, teacher, or purpose of life for me, who is without limitations and is pure consciousness?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Where is instruction, scripture, disciple, teacher, or purpose of life for me, who is without limitations and is pure consciousness?

sanskrit_shloka:
क्व चास्ति क्व च वा नास्ति क्वास्ति चैकं क्व च द्वयम् ।
बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन किञ्चिन्नोत्तिष्ठते मम ॥ २०-१४॥
transliteration:
kva cāsti kva ca vā nāsti kvāsti caikaṃ kva ca dvayam .
bahunātra kimuktena kiñcinnottiṣṭhate mama .. 20-14..
translation: Where is existence or non-existence? Where is oneness or duality? What more can be said when nothing arises in me?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Where is existence or non-existence? Where is oneness or duality? What more can be said when nothing arises in me?

sanskrit_shloka:
इति अष्टावक्रगीता समाप्ता ।
॥ ॐ तत्सत् ॥
transliteration:
iti aṣṭāvakragītā samāptā .
.. oṃ tatsat ..
translation: Thus ends the Aṣṭāvakra Gītā.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Thus ends the Aṣṭāvakra Gītā.

sanskrit_shloka:
येन दृष्टं परं ब्रह्म सोऽहं ब्रह्मेति चिन्तयेत् ।
किं चिन्तयति निश्चिन्तो द्वितीयं यो न पश्यति ॥ १८-१६॥
transliteration:
yena dṛṣṭaṃ paraṃ brahma so'haṃ brahmeti cintayet .
kiṃ cintayati niścinto dvitīyaṃ yo na paśyati .. 18-16..
translation: The one who has realized the supreme Brahman may think "I am Brahman," but what does he actually think, being free from all worry and not seeing duality?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The one who has realized the supreme Brahman may think "I am Brahman," but what does he actually think, being free from all worry and not seeing duality?

sanskrit_shloka:
दृष्टो येनात्मविक्षेपो निरोधं कुरुते त्वसौ ।
उदारस्तु न विक्षिप्तः साध्याभावात्करोति किम् ॥ १८-१७॥
transliteration:
dṛṣṭo yenātmavikṣepo nirodhaṃ kurute tvasau .
udārastu na vikṣiptaḥ sādhyābhāvātkaroti kim .. 18-17..
translation: The one who suppresses distractions of the self does so after having seen them, but the noble one, being undistracted and without objectives, does nothing.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The one who suppresses distractions of the self does so after having seen them, but the noble one, being undistracted and without objectives, does nothing.

sanskrit_shloka:
धीरो लोकविपर्यस्तो वर्तमानोऽपि लोकवत् ।
न समाधिं न विक्षेपं न लोपं स्वस्य पश्यति ॥ १८-१८॥
transliteration:
dhīro lokaviparyasto vartamāno'pi lokavat .
na samādhiṃ na vikṣepaṃ na lopaṃ svasya paśyati .. 18-18..
translation: The wise one, though existing in the world like others, neither sees deep meditation, distraction, nor any loss within himself.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The wise one, though existing in the world like others, neither sees deep meditation, distraction, nor any loss within himself.

sanskrit_shloka:
भावाभावविहीनो यस्तृप्तो निर्वासनो बुधः ।
नैव किञ्चित्कृतं तेन लोकदृष्ट्या विकुर्वता ॥ १८-१९॥
transliteration:
bhāvābhāvavihīno yastṛpto nirvāsano budhaḥ .
naiva kiñcitkṛtaṃ tena lokadṛṣṭyā vikurvatā .. 18-19..
translation: The wise one, who is free from concepts of existence and non-existence, content, and free from desires, is seen by the world as acting, though in reality, he does nothing.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The wise one, who is free from concepts of existence and non-existence, content, and free from desires, is seen by the world as acting, though in reality, he does nothing.

sanskrit_shloka:
प्रवृत्तौ वा निवृत्तौ वा नैव धीरस्य दुर्ग्रहः ।
यदा यत्कर्तुमायाति तत्कृत्वा तिष्ठतः सुखम् ॥ १८-२०॥
transliteration:
pravṛttau vā nivṛttau vā naiva dhīrasya durgrahaḥ .
yadā yatkartumāyāti tatkṛtvā tiṣṭhataḥ sukham .. 18-20..
translation: For the wise one, there is no difficulty whether in action or non-action. He simply does what comes to be done and remains happy.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: For the wise one, there is no difficulty whether in action or non-action. He simply does what comes to be done and remains happy.

sanskrit_shloka:
निर्वासनो निरालम्बः स्वच्छन्दो मुक्तबन्धनः ।
क्षिप्तः संस्कारवातेन चेष्टते शुष्कपर्णवत् ॥ १८-२१॥
transliteration:
nirvāsano nirālambaḥ svacchando muktabandhanaḥ .
kṣiptaḥ saṃskāravātena ceṣṭate śuṣkaparṇavat .. 18-21..
translation: The desireless, self-reliant, and free-willed one, though liberated from all bondage, moves as if tossed by the wind of past impressions, like a dry leaf.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The desireless, self-reliant, and free-willed one, though liberated from all bondage, moves as if tossed by the wind of past impressions, like a dry leaf.

sanskrit_shloka:
असंसारस्य तु क्वापि न हर्षो न विषादता ।
स शीतलमना नित्यं विदेह इव राजये ॥ १८-२२॥
transliteration:
asaṃsārasya tu kvāpi na harṣo na viṣādatā .
sa śītalamanā nityaṃ videha iva rājaye .. 18-22..
translation: For the one beyond worldly life, there is neither joy nor sorrow. With a cool and tranquil mind, he always reigns like one without a body.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: For the one beyond worldly life, there is neither joy nor sorrow. With a cool and tranquil mind, he always reigns like one without a body.

sanskrit_shloka:
कुत्रापि न जिहासास्ति नाशो वापि न कुत्रचित् ।
आत्मारामस्य धीरस्य शीतलाच्छतरात्मनः ॥ १८-२३॥
transliteration:
kutrāpi na jihāsāsti nāśo vāpi na kutracit .
ātmārāmasya dhīrasya śītalācchatarātmanaḥ .. 18-23..
translation: For the wise one who delights in the self and whose mind is pure and tranquil, there is no desire to give up anything, nor is there any fear of destruction, anywhere.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: For the wise one who delights in the self and whose mind is pure and tranquil, there is no desire to give up anything, nor is there any fear of destruction, anywhere.

sanskrit_shloka:
प्रकृत्या शून्यचित्तस्य कुर्वतोऽस्य यदृच्छया ।
प्राकृतस्येव धीरस्य न मानो नावमानता ॥ १८-२४॥
transliteration:
prakṛtyā śūnyacittasya kurvato'sya yadṛcchayā .
prākṛtasyeva dhīrasya na māno nāvamānatā .. 18-24..
translation: For the wise one, whose mind is naturally void and who acts spontaneously, there is neither honor nor dishonor, just as it is for a common person.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: For the wise one, whose mind is naturally void and who acts spontaneously, there is neither honor nor dishonor, just as it is for a common person.

sanskrit_shloka:
कृतं देहेन कर्मेदं न मया शुद्धरूपिणा ।
इति चिन्तानुरोधी यः कुर्वन्नपि करोति न ॥ १८-२५॥
transliteration:
kṛtaṃ dehena karmedaṃ na mayā śuddharūpiṇā .
iti cintānurodhī yaḥ kurvannapi karoti na .. 18-25..
translation: The one who thinks "this action is done by the body, not by me, who am pure by nature" does not act, even while performing actions.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The one who thinks "this action is done by the body, not by me, who am pure by nature" does not act, even while performing actions.

sanskrit_shloka:
अतद्वादीव कुरुते न भवेदपि बालिशः ।
जीवन्मुक्तः सुखी श्रीमान् संसरन्नपि शोभते ॥ १८-२६॥
transliteration:
atadvādīva kurute na bhavedapi bāliśaḥ .
jīvanmuktaḥ sukhī śrīmān saṃsarannapi śobhate .. 18-26..
translation: The liberated one, even while appearing to engage in worldly actions, is not childish. The enlightened one, ever content and glorious, shines even in the midst of worldly life.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The liberated one, even while appearing to engage in worldly actions, is not childish. The enlightened one, ever content and glorious, shines even in the midst of worldly life.

sanskrit_shloka:
नानाविचारसुश्रान्तो धीरो विश्रान्तिमागतः ।
न कल्पते न जानाति न श‍ृणोति न पश्यति ॥ १८-२७॥
transliteration:
nānāvicārasuśrānto dhīro viśrāntimāgataḥ .
na kalpate na jānāti na śṛṇoti na paśyati .. 18-27..
translation: The wise one, having become exhausted with diverse thoughts and having attained rest, no longer imagines, knows, hears, or sees in the ordinary sense.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The wise one, having become exhausted with diverse thoughts and having attained rest, no longer imagines, knows, hears, or sees in the ordinary sense.

sanskrit_shloka:
असमाधेरविक्षेपान् न मुमुक्षुर्न चेतरः ।
निश्चित्य कल्पितं पश्यन् ब्रह्मैवास्ते महाशयः ॥ १८-२८॥
transliteration:
asamādheravikṣepān na mumukṣurna cetaraḥ .
niścitya kalpitaṃ paśyan brahmaivāste mahāśayaḥ .. 18-28..
translation: Neither in samādhi nor distracted, neither desiring liberation nor its opposite, the great soul, having realized the imagined, remains established in Brahman.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Neither in samādhi nor distracted, neither desiring liberation nor its opposite, the great soul, having realized the imagined, remains established in Brahman.

sanskrit_shloka:
यस्यान्तः स्यादहङ्कारो न करोति करोति सः ।
निरहङ्कारधीरेण न किञ्चिदकृतं कृतम् ॥ १८-२९॥
transliteration:
yasyāntaḥ syādahaṅkāro na karoti karoti saḥ .
nirahaṅkāradhīreṇa na kiñcidakṛtaṃ kṛtam .. 18-29..
translation: One who has ego within acts, but the wise one without ego does nothing, though appearing to do everything.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: One who has ego within acts, but the wise one without ego does nothing, though appearing to do everything.

sanskrit_shloka:
नोद्विग्नं न च सन्तुष्टमकर्तृ स्पन्दवर्जितम् ।
निराशं गतसन्देहं चित्तं मुक्तस्य राजते ॥ १८-३०॥
transliteration:
nodvignaṃ na ca santuṣṭamakartṛ spandavarjitam .
nirāśaṃ gatasandehaṃ cittaṃ muktasya rājate .. 18-30..
translation: The mind of the liberated one is neither disturbed nor satisfied, devoid of action and movement, free of hope and doubt, and it shines in its own glory.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The mind of the liberated one is neither disturbed nor satisfied, devoid of action and movement, free of hope and doubt, and it shines in its own glory.

sanskrit_shloka:
निर्ध्यातुं चेष्टितुं वापि यच्चित्तं न प्रवर्तते ।
निर्निमित्तमिदं किन्तु निर्ध्यायेति विचेष्टते ॥ १८-३१॥
transliteration:
nirdhyātuṃ ceṣṭituṃ vāpi yaccittaṃ na pravartate .
nirnimittamidaṃ kintu nirdhyāyeti viceṣṭate .. 18-31..
translation: The mind neither meditates nor acts. It functions without any cause, simply continuing to exist.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The mind neither meditates nor acts. It functions without any cause, simply continuing to exist.

sanskrit_shloka:
तत्त्वं यथार्थमाकर्ण्य मन्दः प्राप्नोति मूढताम् ।
अथवा याति सङ्कोचममूढः कोऽपि मूढवत् ॥ १८-३२॥
transliteration:
tattvaṃ yathārthamākarṇya mandaḥ prāpnoti mūḍhatām .
athavā yāti saṅkocamamūḍhaḥ ko'pi mūḍhavat .. 18-32..
translation: Upon hearing the truth as it is, the dull one becomes confused, while the wise one may contract, appearing like the ignorant.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Upon hearing the truth as it is, the dull one becomes confused, while the wise one may contract, appearing like the ignorant.

sanskrit_shloka:
एकाग्रता निरोधो वा मूढैरभ्यस्यते भृशम् ।
धीराः कृत्यं न पश्यन्ति सुप्तवत्स्वपदे स्थिताः ॥ १८-३३॥
transliteration:
ekāgratā nirodho vā mūḍhairabhyasyate bhṛśam .
dhīrāḥ kṛtyaṃ na paśyanti suptavatsvapade sthitāḥ .. 18-33..
translation: One-pointedness or cessation is practiced excessively by the ignorant, while the wise, like one asleep, see no action to be done and are established in their natural state.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: One-pointedness or cessation is practiced excessively by the ignorant, while the wise, like one asleep, see no action to be done and are established in their natural state.

sanskrit_shloka:
अप्रयत्नात् प्रयत्नाद् वा मूढो नाप्नोति निर्वृतिम् ।
तत्त्वनिश्चयमात्रेण प्राज्ञो भवति निर्वृतः ॥ १८-३४॥
transliteration:
aprayatnāt prayatnād vā mūḍho nāpnoti nirvṛtim .
tattvaniścayamātreṇa prājño bhavati nirvṛtaḥ .. 18-34..
translation: Whether with effort or without, the ignorant do not attain liberation. Simply through the certainty of truth, the wise one becomes liberated.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Whether with effort or without, the ignorant do not attain liberation. Simply through the certainty of truth, the wise one becomes liberated.

sanskrit_shloka:
शुद्धं बुद्धं प्रियं पूर्णं निष्प्रपञ्चं निरामयम् ।
आत्मानं तं न जानन्ति तत्राभ्यासपरा जनाः ॥ १८-३५॥
transliteration:
śuddhaṃ buddhaṃ priyaṃ pūrṇaṃ niṣprapañcaṃ nirāmayam .
ātmānaṃ taṃ na jānanti tatrābhyāsaparā janāḥ .. 18-35..
translation: People who are engrossed in practices do not realize the pure, enlightened, dear, complete, non-dual, and suffering-free Self.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: People who are engrossed in practices do not realize the pure, enlightened, dear, complete, non-dual, and suffering-free Self.

sanskrit_shloka:
नाप्नोति कर्मणा मोक्षं विमूढोऽभ्यासरूपिणा ।
धन्यो विज्ञानमात्रेण मुक्तस्तिष्ठत्यविक्रियः ॥ १८-३६॥
transliteration:
nāpnoti karmaṇā mokṣaṃ vimūḍho'bhyāsarūpiṇā .
dhanyo vijñānamātreṇa muktastiṣṭhatyavikriyaḥ .. 18-36..
translation: The deluded one does not attain liberation even through actions or practices. The blessed one, through mere knowledge, remains liberated and unchanged.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The deluded one does not attain liberation even through actions or practices. The blessed one, through mere knowledge, remains liberated and unchanged.

sanskrit_shloka:
मूढो नाप्नोति तद् ब्रह्म यतो भवितुमिच्छति ।
अनिच्छन्नपि धीरो हि परब्रह्मस्वरूपभाक् ॥ १८-३७॥
transliteration:
mūḍho nāpnoti tad brahma yato bhavitumicchati .
anicchannapi dhīro hi parabrahmasvarūpabhāk .. 18-37..
translation: The ignorant do not attain Brahman by desiring to become it. The wise one, without even desiring, naturally possesses the nature of the Supreme Brahman.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The ignorant do not attain Brahman by desiring to become it. The wise one, without even desiring, naturally possesses the nature of the Supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_shloka:
निराधारा ग्रहव्यग्रा मूढाः संसारपोषकाः ।
एतस्यानर्थमूलस्य मूलच्छेदः कृतो बुधैः ॥ १८-३८॥
transliteration:
nirādhārā grahavyagrā mūḍhāḥ saṃsārapoṣakāḥ .
etasyānarthamūlasya mūlacchedaḥ kṛto budhaiḥ .. 18-38..
translation: The ignorant, attached to grasping and without foundation, sustain the cycle of worldly existence. The wise, however, have cut the root of this harmful existence.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The ignorant, attached to grasping and without foundation, sustain the cycle of worldly existence. The wise, however, have cut the root of this harmful existence.

sanskrit_shloka:
न शान्तिं लभते मूढो यतः शमितुमिच्छति ।
धीरस्तत्त्वं विनिश्चित्य सर्वदा शान्तमानसः ॥ १८-३९॥
transliteration:
na śāntiṃ labhate mūḍho yataḥ śamitumicchati .
dhīrastattvaṃ viniścitya sarvadā śāntamānasaḥ .. 18-39..
translation: The deluded one does not attain peace, as he is constantly trying to quiet his mind. The wise one, having realized the truth, is always peaceful in mind.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The deluded one does not attain peace, as he is constantly trying to quiet his mind. The wise one, having realized the truth, is always peaceful in mind.

sanskrit_shloka:
क्वात्मनो दर्शनं तस्य यद् दृष्टमवलम्बते ।
धीरास्तं तं न पश्यन्ति पश्यन्त्यात्मानमव्ययम् ॥ १८-४०॥
transliteration:
kvātmano darśanaṃ tasya yad dṛṣṭamavalambate .
dhīrāstaṃ taṃ na paśyanti paśyantyātmānamavyayam .. 18-40..
translation: Where is the vision of the Self for one who clings to what is seen? The wise ones do not see the external but instead see the imperishable Self.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Where is the vision of the Self for one who clings to what is seen? The wise ones do not see the external but instead see the imperishable Self.

sanskrit_shloka:
क्व निरोधो विमूढस्य यो निर्बन्धं करोति वै ।
स्वारामस्यैव धीरस्य सर्वदासावकृत्रिमः ॥ १८-४१॥
transliteration:
kva nirodho vimūḍhasya yo nirbandhaṃ karoti vai .
svārāmasyaiva dhīrasya sarvadāsāvakṛtrimaḥ .. 18-41..
translation: Where is cessation for the deluded one who insists on controlling things? The wise one, always self-contented, remains without any artificiality.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Where is cessation for the deluded one who insists on controlling things? The wise one, always self-contented, remains without any artificiality.

sanskrit_shloka:
भावस्य भावकः कश्चिन् न किञ्चिद् भावकोपरः ।
उभयाभावकः कश्चिद् एवमेव निराकुलः ॥ १८-४२॥
transliteration:
bhāvasya bhāvakaḥ kaścin na kiñcid bhāvakoparaḥ .
ubhayābhāvakaḥ kaścid evameva nirākulaḥ .. 18-42..
translation: Some see existence as a creator, but there is none superior to that. Some, seeing both existence and non-existence as illusions, remain undisturbed.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Some see existence as a creator, but there is none superior to that. Some, seeing both existence and non-existence as illusions, remain undisturbed.

sanskrit_shloka:
शुद्धमद्वयमात्मानं भावयन्ति कुबुद्धयः ।
न तु जानन्ति संमोहाद्यावज्जीवमनिर्वृताः ॥ १८-४३॥
transliteration:
śuddhamadvayamātmānaṃ bhāvayanti kubuddhayaḥ .
na tu jānanti saṃmohādyāvajjīvamanirvṛtāḥ .. 18-43..
translation: The deluded foolishly meditate on the pure, non-dual Self but do not realize it due to their delusions, remaining unsatisfied throughout life.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The deluded foolishly meditate on the pure, non-dual Self but do not realize it due to their delusions, remaining unsatisfied throughout life.

sanskrit_shloka:
मुमुक्षोर्बुद्धिरालम्बमन्तरेण न विद्यते ।
निरालम्बैव निष्कामा बुद्धिर्मुक्तस्य सर्वदा ॥ १८-४४॥
transliteration:
mumukṣorbuddhirālambamantareṇa na vidyate .
nirālambaiva niṣkāmā buddhirmuktasya sarvadā .. 18-44..
translation: The intellect of one desiring liberation cannot exist without some support. The intellect of the liberated one, however, is always without support and free from desire.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The intellect of one desiring liberation cannot exist without some support. The intellect of the liberated one, however, is always without support and free from desire.

sanskrit_shloka:
विषयद्वीपिनो वीक्ष्य चकिताः शरणार्थिनः ।
विशन्ति झटिति क्रोडं निरोधैकाग्रसिद्धये ॥ १८-४५॥
transliteration:
viṣayadvīpino vīkṣya cakitāḥ śaraṇārthinaḥ .
viśanti jhaṭiti kroḍaṃ nirodhaikāgrasiddhaye .. 18-45..
translation: Seeing the tigers of sense objects, terrified seekers quickly seek refuge in the embrace of focused cessation.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Seeing the tigers of sense objects, terrified seekers quickly seek refuge in the embrace of focused cessation.

sanskrit_shloka:
निर्वासनं हरिं दृष्ट्वा तूष्णीं विषयदन्तिनः ।
पलायन्ते न शक्तास्ते सेवन्ते कृतचाटवः ॥ १८-४६॥
transliteration:
nirvāsanaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā tūṣṇīṃ viṣayadantinaḥ .
palāyante na śaktāste sevante kṛtacāṭavaḥ .. 18-46..
translation: Seeing the pure, desireless one, the powerful sense desires silently flee, unable to dominate; instead, they serve humbly, like submissive flatterers.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Seeing the pure, desireless one, the powerful sense desires silently flee, unable to dominate; instead, they serve humbly, like submissive flatterers.

sanskrit_shloka:
न मुक्तिकारिकां धत्ते निःशङ्को युक्तमानसः ।
पश्यन् श‍ृण्वन् स्पृशन् जिघ्रन्नश्नन्नास्ते यथासुखम् ॥ १८-४७॥
transliteration:
na muktikārikāṃ dhatte niḥśaṅko yuktamānasaḥ .
paśyan śṛṇvan spṛśan jighrannaśnannāste yathāsukham .. 18-47..
translation: The one with a steady mind, free from doubt, holds no thought of liberation. Whether seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, or eating, he remains at ease in whatever comes his way.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The one with a steady mind, free from doubt, holds no thought of liberation. Whether seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, or eating, he remains at ease in whatever comes his way.

sanskrit_shloka:
वस्तुश्रवणमात्रेण शुद्धबुद्धिर्निराकुलः ।
नैवाचारमनाचारमौदास्यं वा प्रपश्यति ॥ १८-४८॥
transliteration:
vastuśravaṇamātreṇa śuddhabuddhirnirākulaḥ .
naivācāramanācāramaudāsyaṃ vā prapaśyati .. 18-48..
translation: The pure-minded one, undisturbed, having heard the truth, does not see conduct as good or bad, nor does he see indifference; all are irrelevant.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The pure-minded one, undisturbed, having heard the truth, does not see conduct as good or bad, nor does he see indifference; all are irrelevant.

sanskrit_shloka:
यदा यत्कर्तुमायाति तदा तत्कुरुते ऋजुः ।
शुभं वाप्यशुभं वापि तस्य चेष्टा हि बालवत् ॥ १८-४९॥
transliteration:
yadā yatkartumāyāti tadā tatkurute ṛjuḥ .
śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ vāpi tasya ceṣṭā hi bālavat .. 18-49..
translation: When whatever action arises to be done, the simple and straightforward one does it, whether it is good or bad, with a childlike spontaneity.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: When whatever action arises to be done, the simple and straightforward one does it, whether it is good or bad, with a childlike spontaneity.

sanskrit_shloka:
स्वातन्त्र्यात्सुखमाप्नोति स्वातन्त्र्याल्लभते परम् ।
स्वातन्त्र्यान्निर्वृतिं गच्छेत्स्वातन्त्र्यात् परमं पदम् ॥ १८-५०॥
transliteration:
svātantryātsukhamāpnoti svātantryāllabhate param .
svātantryānnirvṛtiṃ gacchetsvātantryāt paramaṃ padam .. 18-50..
translation: From freedom comes happiness, from freedom comes the supreme attainment, from freedom comes liberation, and from freedom comes the highest state.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: From freedom comes happiness, from freedom comes the supreme attainment, from freedom comes liberation, and from freedom comes the highest state.
